note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. Every building, space, participant and datum is generic and fictional; only the partition datum is substituted and only the closure it names changes. Nothing states who may attend, a secrecy or confidentiality rule, a vote, a hierarchy, a time span or any outcome.
